sources.measurement: Exhaust duct sensors plus Type-K pan center/intermediate thermocouples, 4-second cadence
sources.usage: Pan TC center and Pre-Ignition labels: external temperature-only risk benchmark; excluded from model training, threshold tuning and prototype claims
Sensor range, emissivity and field-of-view limitations; no extracted training samples
Methodological precedent for thermal simulation; no copying of reported accuracy or dataset

sources.parameters: Engineering assumptions, not fitted to the prototype: pan 500–1000 J/K (OOD 1100–1500), power 850–1900 W, loss 2–5 W/K, food contact 10–24 W/K, food 0.1–0.35 kg, emissivity 0.85, area 0.035 m², sensor lag 1 s, noise sd 0.5 °C. Stefan–Boltzmann constant SI; evaporation 2.256 MJ/kg approximation near water boiling. No claimed universal calibration.
